rc022_narrow_public_projection.interpretation: Previous public-safe projection; not the full SPOT frontier.

source_row.provisional_definition: A named dimension of variation within a description.
source_row.type_signature: Axis(D) := typed coordinate/ordering/distinction dimension in D
source_row.falsifier_or_check: The axis adds no distinguishable variation.

source_row.provisional_definition: A rule, threshold, surface, or distinction governing separation or crossing.
source_row.type_signature: Boundary(C) := separation/crossing predicate or rule on a continuum
source_row.falsifier_or_check: Crossing or separation criteria are absent.

source_row.provisional_definition: Loss of the configuration ability to maintain relevant organization under active constraints.
source_row.type_signature: Collapse := failure of organization predicate under active constraints

source_row.provisional_definition: A condition that a description, state, or transformation must satisfy.
A structured range of possible states or descriptions along one or more axes.
source_row.type_signature: Continuum := states plus structure over axes
source_row.falsifier_or_check: No ordering, adjacency, metric, topology, or transition relation is given.

source_row.provisional_definition: An incompatibility among active constraints under the current description.
source_row.type_signature: Contradiction_D := finite active constraints not jointly satisfiable under D
source_row.falsifier_or_check: The incompatibility can be resolved inside the current description.

source_row.provisional_definition: A typed representation frame for a system, with named observables and admissible distinctions.
source_row.type_signature: Description := (objects, observables, distinctions, admissible operations, failure tests)
source_row.falsifier_or_check: No observables or distinctions are named.

source_row.provisional_definition: Introduction of a new axis necessary to preserve or restore intelligibility under active constraints.
source_row.type_signature: DimensionBirth := extension D -> D+axis such that old D fails and extended D restores target adequacy
source_row.falsifier_or_check: The new axis is not necessary or improves no prediction/explanation/compression.

source_row.provisional_definition: A transformation acting on states, boundaries, axes, continua, or descriptions.
source_row.type_signature: Operator := typed map with domain, codomain, preserved structure, lost structure
source_row.falsifier_or_check: Domain/codomain and preservation/loss conditions are absent.

source_row.provisional_definition: A transformation or refinement that removes incompatibility without losing required organization.
source_row.type_signature: Resolution := operator or description refinement satisfying active constraints
source_row.falsifier_or_check: Neither preservation nor incompatibility removal is shown.

source_row.provisional_definition: A located configuration of a system within a description.
source_row.type_signature: State(S,D) := admissible location/configuration of S under D

source_row.provisional_definition: The object or configuration being described under a selected description.
source_row.falsifier_or_check: The object boundary cannot be stated.

source_row.label: K12 - semantic super-continuum and global coherence
source_row.invariant_required: Required: invariant distinguishing this level from neighbors and showing why article scope needs it.

source_row.label: Birth
source_row.provisional_type_signature: Description -> Description with new axis/object/continuum component
source_row.intended_role: Introduce a new descriptive entity or axis when old frame is inadequate.
source_row.independence_model_required: Required: model where this operator is indispensable relative to the other five.

source_row.label: Differentiate
source_row.intended_role: Split, refine, or distinguish previously fused states or axes.
source_row.independence_model_required: Required: model where this operator is indispensable relative to the other five.

source_row.label: Kill
source_row.intended_role: Terminate inadmissible, collapsed, or refuted structure.
source_row.independence_model_required: Required: model where this operator is indispensable relative to the other five.

source_row.label: Project
source_row.provisional_type_signature: Source description -> target description with stated preservation/loss
source_row.intended_role: Map structure between levels or domains while naming lost information.
source_row.independence_model_required: Required: model where this operator is indispensable relative to the other five.

source_row.label: Repair
source_row.intended_role: Restore adequacy by changing boundary, axis, operator, or constraint package.
source_row.independence_model_required: Required: model where this operator is indispensable relative to the other five.

source_row.label: Stabilize
source_row.intended_role: Preserve organization under allowed perturbation or repair.
source_row.independence_model_required: Required: model where this operator is indispensable relative to the other five.

source_row.verification_note: Proof derives required claim fields from primitive definitions and the bounded central axiom schema; it is an admissibility theorem, not empirical validation.

source_row.title: Bounded Article Eligibility Theorem
source_row.exact_statement: The closed 024 core is article-eligible only as a bounded axiomatic theory with explicit conjectural exclusions and no universal-law wording.
source_row.falsifier: The article draft uses stronger wording than the proof ledger permits.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: No promoted wording exceeds DB proof status and boundary file.

source_row.title: Central principle theorem/axiom/refutation decision
source_row.exact_statement: An unresolved contradiction either gives rise to a new dimension of description or collapses the configuration that cannot resolve it.
source_row.falsifier: A persistent unresolved contradiction exists that neither requires a new axis nor damages the relevant configuration, under the stated trigger conditions.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Decide PROVED_THEOREM, AXIOM_ACCEPTED_WITH_BOUNDARY, or REFUTED_AND_REPAIRED with proof/countermodel and article boundary.

source_row.title: Crown Stones Excluded From Core
source_row.exact_statement: Crown-stone claims are conjectural extensions unless individually bound to a closed theorem chain.
source_row.falsifier: A crown-stone claim is promoted while its dependency path is open.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Map each crown-stone claim to proof chain or mark conjectural/excluded.

source_row.title: Primitive vocabulary package
source_row.exact_statement: Define description, system, state, axis, continuum, boundary, operator, constraint, contradiction, resolution, collapse, and dimension birth with type signatures and falsifier checks.
source_row.falsifier: A term has no type signature, source anchor, or failure check.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: All primitive definitions have source refs, type signatures, counterexample/falsifier checks, and no circular dependence on the central principle.

source_row.title: Domain Projections Excluded From Core
source_row.exact_statement: Domain projections are applications requiring local variables, constraints, operators, organization predicates, evidence, and falsifiers; they are not core validation.
source_row.falsifier: A projection is treated as global validation without local evidence and falsifier.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Bind each projection to local evidence or exclude from core article.

source_row.title: K0-K12 hierarchy definition package
source_row.exact_statement: OC source K-levels K0 through K12 form a stated hierarchy from distinguishability to semantic super-continuum/global coherence.
source_row.falsifier: A level lacks a definition, invariant, construction rule, or distinctness condition.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Recover definitions, construction rule, invariants, and article boundary for each level.

source_row.title: Adjacent K-Level Non-Recovery Theorem
source_row.exact_statement: Adjacent K-levels are non-collapsible under the 024 typed-extension formalism when the higher level carries a typed invariant not definable from the lower-level reduct.
source_row.falsifier: Two levels are interdefinable without loss in the selected model class.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Prove distinctness or demote affected levels to conjectural extension.

source_row.title: K-Level Count and Partition Repair
source_row.exact_statement: The strong claim that K0-K12 is a unique, exhaustive, or minimal hierarchy is not proved; it is repaired to a source-bound ladder plus typed adjacent non-recovery.
source_row.falsifier: A different partition covers the same phenomena with equal or better invariants and fewer assumptions.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Prove count/partition theorem or restrict article scope to a proved subhierarchy.

source_row.title: Law Candidate Classification Rule
source_row.exact_statement: Every OC law-like statement must be classified as theorem consequence, axiom schema, empirical/domain conjecture, or excluded metaphor.
source_row.falsifier: A law-like sentence has no status class or proof/evidence boundary.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Classify all law candidates before publication wording.

source_row.title: Operator catalog recovery
source_row.exact_statement: The OC operator catalog consists of Birth, Differentiate, Stabilize, Project, Kill, and Repair as source-bound operator nodes.
source_row.falsifier: A source-required operator is missing or a listed operator lacks a role/type signature.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Recover exact list, roles, type signatures, closure/composition obligations, and article boundary.

source_row.title: Operator minimality and independence
source_row.exact_statement: The source operator set is locally minimal for the chosen OC formalism.
source_row.falsifier: One operator can be defined from the others without loss over the stated model class.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Provide one independence model per operator or repair the minimality claim.

source_row.title: Operator closure and composition laws
source_row.exact_statement: OC operators have well-defined closure and composition behavior over typed descriptions.
source_row.falsifier: A claimed composition has no domain/codomain or violates preservation/loss conditions.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: State closure/composition laws and prove them in the selected formalism.

source_row.title: OC Claim Admissibility Theorem
source_row.exact_statement: Any article-eligible OC claim invoking the central schema must name description, system, active constraints, target organization predicate, admissible same-description repair/operator class, unresolvedness argument, and either necessary new axis or collapse certificate.
source_row.falsifier: All consequences are definitional restatements or circular.
source_row.acceptance_criteria: Produce a theorem with assumptions, proof, countermodel boundary, and independent verification.
